name: Primal Fury
text: [Trait] All `BEASTMEN RAIDERS` fighters have this trait. While this fighter is wounded, you may add 1 to its Fight characteristic. It automatically passes any Bravery test it is required to take, but it cannot make reactions.

name: Raider Ambush
text: [Trait] All `BEASTMEN RAIDERS` fighters have this trait. Add 1 to the move characteristic of this fighter in the battle round in which they are deployed to the battlefield.
